# Project

`sentry.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1` · Namespaced · [all resources](../README.md)

| Operation | Request |
|---|---|
| observe | `GET /api/0/projects/{organization_id_or_slug}/{project_id_or_slug}/` |
| create | `POST /api/0/teams/{organization_id_or_slug}/{team_id_or_slug}/projects/` |
| update | `PUT /api/0/projects/{organization_id_or_slug}/{project_id_or_slug}/` |
| delete | `DELETE /api/0/projects/{organization_id_or_slug}/{project_id_or_slug}/` |

References: `organizationRef` → Organization / ClusterOrganization, `teamRef` → Team.

Credentials: via organization.

## Example

```yaml
apiVersion: sentry.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Project
metadata:

  forProvider:

      name: <name>
```

## Spec

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deletionPolicy` | string |  | `Orphan` keeps the external resource when the managed resource is deleted. Without `Delete` in `managementPolicies` the resource is always orphaned. One of `Delete`, `Orphan`. Default `Delete`. |
| `forProvider` | object | yes | `spec.forProvider`: the generated API fields plus references and credentials. |
| `forProvider.default_rules` | boolean |  | Defaults to true where the behavior is to alert the user on every new issue. Setting this to false will turn this off and the user must create their own alerts to be notified of new issues. |
| `forProvider.name` | string | yes | The name for the project. |
| `forProvider.organizationRef` | object |  | A reference to an object of kind `Organization` (default) in the namespace of the resource holding the reference, or of kind `ClusterOrganization`, by `kind`. |
| `forProvider.organizationRef.apiVersion` | string |  | `apiVersion` of the referenced object; needed when its kind is in several groups. |
| `forProvider.organizationRef.kind` | string |  | One of `Organization`, `ClusterOrganization`. Default `Organization`. |
| `forProvider.organizationRef.name` | string | yes |  |
| `forProvider.platform` | string |  | The platform for the project. |
| `forProvider.slug` | string |  | Uniquely identifies a project and is used for the interface. If not provided, it is automatically generated from the name. |
| `forProvider.teamRef` | object |  | A reference to another managed resource: a namespaced resource in the namespace of the resource holding the reference, or a cluster-scoped one. |
| `forProvider.teamRef.name` | string | yes |  |
| `managementPolicies` | []string |  | Actions the controller may take. `["*"]` (default) allows all; `["Observe"]` only reads (import without management). `Observe` is always required. Default `["*"]`. |

Validation:

- `forProvider`: organizationRef cannot be removed once set
- `forProvider.organizationRef`: organizationRef is immutable
